name: resource-xsi-schema-location
rule: xsi:schemaLocation is allowed on any element (R2 shop resources use it)

name: request-xsi-schema-location
rule: xsi attributes are allowed on a child element too

name: resource-xsi-nil
rule: xsi:nil on an element that is not nillable

name: document-child-without-namespace
rule: child elements must be in the namespace

name: document-text-in-resource
rule: character data between elements of Resource

name: document-text-in-request
rule: character data between elements of Request

name: resource-auth
rule: auth attribute starting with a letter

name: resource-version-three-parts
rule: v must be a number (1.0.1 is not)

name: resource-auth-digit-first
rule: auth must start with a letter

name: resource-auth-empty
rule: auth must start with a letter (empty has no first letter)

name: desc-after-request
rule: Desc must come before the Requests

name: desc-twice
rule: only one Desc before the Requests

name: request-item-any-string
rule: item is any string, not a boolean

name: request-item-false-is-still-an-item
rule: item="false" is accepted by the schema (Mason treats any non-blank value as an item request)

name: request-method-patch
rule: PATCH is not in the method list

name: request-method-item-duplicate-named
rule: same method and the same item string twice

name: request-duplicate-method-without-item-is-not-checked
rule: xsd:unique ignores requests without item: two plain GETs pass the schema

name: id-duplicate-across-requests
rule: ids are unique across all requests

name: id-duplicate-sql-and-text
rule: a Sql and a Text with the same id

name: id-duplicate-same-request
rule: two steps with the same id in one request

name: id-duplicate-script-xrequest
rule: a Script and an XRequest with the same id

name: id-duplicate-inside-transaction
rule: MQ rejects what the schema misses: the same id inside a Transaction twice (mpath could not tell them apart)

name: id-transaction-sql-collides-with-step
rule: MQ rejects a Sql inside a Transaction that reuses the id of a step outside

name: sql-limit-offset-query
rule: limit and offset on a query

name: sql-limit-starts-with-digit
rule: limit must start with a letter

name: sql-offset-starts-with-digit
rule: offset must start with a letter

name: sql-unknown-attribute-persist
rule: persist is not an attribute (old dialect)

name: sql-limit-on-update
rule: limit/offset are only allowed on queries (R2 Java throws SAXException)

name: transaction-sql-without-id
rule: Sql inside Transaction still needs an id

name: xrequest-output-maybe
rule: output is true, false or headers

name: xrequest-header-empty-name
rule: Header name must not be empty

name: param-type-string
rule: string is not a Param type

name: when-and-or-not-empty
rule: when with and, or, not, empty and parentheses

name: when-mpath-boolean
rule: when comparing a step result with true

name: mpath-in-when-earlier
rule: mpath in a when condition to an earlier step

name: mpath-in-text
rule: a request parameter that looks like an mpath-free variable

name: mpath-in-transaction-earlier
rule: mpath inside a Transaction to a step before it

name: mpath-unknown-id
rule: mpath to an id that does not exist (R2: "Could not find element with ID")

name: mpath-forward-reference
rule: mpath to a step declared later

name: mpath-self-reference
rule: a step cannot read its own result

name: mpath-in-when-unknown
rule: mpath in a when condition to an unknown id

name: mpath-in-xrequest-url-unknown
rule: mpath in an XRequest url to an unknown id

name: mpath-in-transaction-unknown
rule: mpath in a Transaction Sql to an unknown id

name: mpath-other-request
rule: mpath to a step of another Request is not available
